digest.component_or_area: plan-review sizing and context-limit retry logic
propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share an identical 1,000,000 token context window, so escalating from one to the other buys no additional capacity yet incurs opus pricing and a second failed round-trip.

A context-limit retry that escalates to an identically-windowed rung silently fails again, masking the true diagnosis (no real escalation occurred) behind a false one (even the largest model cannot fit it).
escalation_rungs() must filter models_at_or_above() to exclude any rung whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, preventing guaranteed-failing paid calls.
Both context-limit retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and prerequisites.run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs instead of models_at_or_above to apply the filter uniformly.
models_at_or_above and MODEL_LADDER contents remain unchanged; the fix is in consumption, not declaration, so provider stickiness and size budgets are unaffected.
Structural guards enforce that MODEL_LADDER windows are non-decreasing and that escalation_rungs returns strictly increasing windows, preventing future edits from reintroducing the defect.
